error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "[UE 0] CB-RA: Contention resolution timer has expired, RA procedure has failed..."  
Location/Context: Logged in the MAC layer during the random access procedure (function context: nr_Msg3_transmitted and contention-based random access procedure). This error appears multiple times with the contention resolution timer expiring shortly after RA-Msg3 transmission, indicating failure to complete the random access procedure and thus preventing successful RRC connection establishment.
